record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Find classes of ideals I for which the regularity of the radical is no larger than the regularity of the ideal, reg(rad(I)) <= reg(I).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and $S = k[x_0, x_1, \dots, x_n]$ the standard graded polynomial ring. For a homogeneous ideal $I \subseteq S$, let $\operatorname{reg}(I)$ denote the Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity of $I$, that is, the smallest integer $m$ such that for every $i \geq 0$ and every $j > m + i$ one has $\operatorname{Tor}_i^S(I, k)_j = 0$ (equivalently, the minimal generators of the $i$-th syzygy module of $I$ have degree at most $m + i$). Let $\operatorname{rad}(I) = \sqrt{I}$ denote the radical of $I$.

In general, $\operatorname{reg}(\operatorname{rad}(I))$ can be strictly larger than $\operatorname{reg}(I)$. Identify and characterize broad classes of homogeneous ideals $I \subseteq S$ for which the inequality
$$\operatorname{reg}(\operatorname{rad}(I)) \leq \operatorname{reg}(I)$$
holds. In particular, find new sufficient conditions on $I$ (beyond the previously known cases such as monomial ideals, ideals with $S/I$ Buchsbaum, and certain ideals whose radical defines a smooth curve in $\mathbb{P}^3$) which guarantee this inequality.
artifact.status_search_result: The general inequality reg(rad(I)) ≤ reg(I) is known to fail (counterexamples by Chardin–D'Cruz), and it holds in specific classes (monomial ideals, Buchsbaum quotients, certain curves). Identifying further broad classes for which it holds remains an active and open line of investigation, with recent work (2025) still providing partial upper bounds for reg(rad(I)) in terms of reg(I) and related invariants.

status_evidence.title: Regularity of ideals and their radicals
status_evidence.snippet: Ravi's investigation of the relationship between the regularity of ideals and their radicals; positive results for Buchsbaum and monomial cases.
status_evidence.claim: Known positive cases include monomial ideals and ideals with Buchsbaum quotient, motivating the search for further classes.

status_evidence.title: Upper bounds for regularity of radicals of ideals and arithmetic degrees
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work giving upper bounds for reg(rad(I)) in terms of reg(I) and related invariants.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of comparing reg(rad(I)) with reg(I) remains active, with only partial results.

status_evidence.title: Note on the regularity of the radical
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses cases where reg(rad(I)) ≤ reg(I) and notes failure in general (Chardin–D'Cruz counterexamples).
status_evidence.claim: The inequality fails for general homogeneous ideals; finding broad classes where it holds is open.
